stance_basis: paraphrase describes Kiepper congratulating RPSB and agreeing with their proposal for street alignment and cemetery land use
summary: Alan Kiepper, City Manager of Richmond, expressed support for the Randolph planning proposals at a December 7, 1971 meeting with the Randolph Planning Study Board. He congratulated the RPSB on their thorough studies and agreed with their proposal for a new street alignment and the use of approximately 2 acres of unused cemetery land for housing development. No complaints or objections are attributed to him in the document.
